why_ai: Workflow software under bias-audit rules, facing AI-native recruiting platforms that automate screening and sourcing.
why_clarity: Millions of identical workflow events, but no one grades whether rejected candidates would have succeeded.
why_digital: Applications, screens and hires are recorded and processed entirely in software.

why_ai: An adversarial arms race fought entirely between generative tools on both sides.
why_clarity: Volume is enormous, but what counts as signal shifts as candidates optimise against filters.
why_digital: Generated applications in, automated filters out, all online.

why_ai: Statutory retention and EEO reporting carry legal exposure, but capturing reasons is a form field.
why_clarity: Statutory periods and reporting obligations define exactly what must be retained and reported.
why_digital: Application records and decision logs stored and reported in software.

why_ai: Requires an employer to deliberately hire rejected candidates; an experiment needing human research design, not computation.
why_clarity: Randomisation at the threshold is a codified design, but performance outcomes take years.
why_digital: Hiring data and on-the-job performance records analyzed by researchers.

why_ai: Inferring tacit manager criteria from decisions is a learning problem software can attack.
why_clarity: Managers' real criteria are tacit and unwritten, though accept or reject arrives within days.
why_digital: Candidate submissions and manager decisions exchanged in the ATS.

why_ai: Panel scheduling across calendars is a constrained optimisation problem software solves.
why_clarity: A schedule either satisfies every attendee constraint or it does not, checked instantly.

why_ai: Sampling, blind re-review routing and verdict comparison all automate, despite bias-audit regulation.
why_clarity: Blind re-review against stated requirements yields a measurable disagreement rate.
why_digital: Rejected applications sampled and re-reviewed in software.

why_ai: Ranking and filtering are already automated; bias-audit laws add some accountability.
why_clarity: Rejected candidates produce no outcome data, so screen accuracy can never be checked.
why_digital: Applications in, ranked shortlists out, inside the ATS.

why_ai: Search and outreach over profile data is already highly automated on both sides.
why_clarity: Searches repeat constantly, but whether the best people were found stays unknown.
why_digital: Profile databases in, outreach messages out, all online.

why_ai: Telling candidates their status is a configuration of transitions the ATS already records.
why_clarity: Every status change is a recorded event that either triggers a message or does not.
why_digital: Status data in, candidate notifications out.

why_ai: Candidate and manager relationships remain, while screening, sourcing and scheduling agents absorb the load.
why_clarity: Measured on time-to-fill, with no information on whether hires worked out.
why_digital: Screening, outreach and interviews run on screen and video with remote candidates.
